m1.typescript: m1 hybrid search finds what each single index misses

e1.typescript: e1 chunks overlap and end at the last word

e2.typescript: e2 a rare word outweighs common ones and short chunks win

e3.typescript: e3 fusion rewards agreement and breaks ties by id

e4.typescript: e4 reranking orders the pool by the scorer

e5.typescript: e5 recall counts documents not chunks

e6.typescript: e6 a context sentence makes a bare chunk findable

wrong-no-overlap.defect: moves the window by its whole size, so the overlap is lost

wrong-no-idf.defect: scores every matching word the same, common or rare

wrong-fuse-by-votes.defect: counts the lists that hold an id and ignores its rank in them

wrong-rerank-ascending.defect: puts the lowest scored chunk first

wrong-pool-ignored.defect: reranks the whole ranking instead of the first pool ids

wrong-recall-by-chunk.defect: counts the chunks of a relevant document each time

wrong-context-ignored.defect: indexes the bare chunk text and drops the context sentence
